page.overview:
What is Yaruqtas al-Armani?

Yaruqtas al-Armani is a powerful Assamite of the Dark Ages, known as the "Monk of the Black Mountain". Originally, an Armenian chieftain from, he is a Vizier Caste from Alamut assigned to help further the Clan's efforts in Europe and support his fellow clan-mate Salim Al-Ahzan.
